urlShortener.title: URL Shortener
urlShortener.brief: Design a system that takes a long URL and returns a short URL, redirecting millions of accesses per day.
urlShortener.constraint2: Reads >> writes (redirects are much more frequent)

socialFeed.title: Social Media Feed
socialFeed.brief: Design the backend of a Twitter/Instagram-style feed: users post, follow others, and see a chronological or ranked feed.
socialFeed.constraint1: Fan-out of posts to millions of followers
socialFeed.check1: API Gateway at the entry of requests
socialFeed.check6: CDN to serve media near the user

chatApp.title: Real-Time Chat
chatApp.brief: Design an instant messaging system for 1:1 and group messages, with reliable delivery and online/offline status.
chatApp.check3: Queue to guarantee delivery and ordering

ecommerce.title: E-commerce: Cart & Checkout
ecommerce.brief: Design the cart flow and checkout of a large-scale e-commerce platform, including payment and inventory.
ecommerce.constraint1: Strong consistency in payment and inventory

freeForm.title: Free Mode
freeForm.brief: No constraints — use the canvas to explore any architecture you want to draw.

challenges.footNote: The checklist is a self-assessment guide — check whether each piece makes sense for the scenario, not just whether it is present.
